第八章 利维坦猩猩（上架爆发 求票票+鲜花）
声音传来的方向，正是罗麦格雷尼前所说的水源附近。
两人一前一后跑出山洞，正看见克伦威尔如丧家之犬般狂奔回来。
“怪物……怪物……怪物把……把伊娜抓走了！”克伦威尔的样子看上去异常狼狈，一身华贵的法师袍上沾满了泥砂和树叶，说起话来也是一副上气不接下气的样子。
林立看见这一幕，不由暗自摇了摇头。
这家伙实在太没出息了，也难怪刚才罗麦格雷尼他跟出去的时候，脸色有些不太好看，这种软蛋，老子要是有女儿，也不会高兴你跟她来往……
“什么怪物？你说清楚一点！”事关自己亲生女儿，罗麦格雷尼时急红了眼，瞪着克伦威尔的眼神中，再无先前那种带着一丝疏远的客气。
“刚……刚才……刚才我跟伊娜去打水的时候，旁边忽然冒出一只怪物！它它它……它把伊娜给……”
“靠！”林立扔下一句粗话，再不顾不得去管这个软蛋，又是一记迅捷术补在自己身上，如风一般穿过了茂密的丛林。
丛林之后，是一条潺潺流动的小溪，这大概就是罗麦格雷尼说的水源，在小溪的旁边，一只水袋正静静的落叶上，里面的清水尚未流尽，正咕咚咕咚的往外冒着。
林立弯腰捡起水袋，放在耳边摇了一下，发现里面的清水还有半袋之多。
“应该还没走远！”
再看看地上的脚印，却是异常杂乱，有大有小有深有浅，小的应该是伊娜和克伦威尔留下的，而那大的脚印，却是让林立倒抽了一口凉气！
“利维坦猩猩！”林立相信自己没有看错，这绝对是八级魔兽利维坦猩猩的脚印，早在山上的时候，他就曾经在安度因的小屋外见过一两次，只不过这种时候，老家伙总会轻描淡写的说，几个小痞子想来捣乱，被我给赶走了……
安度因可以当它们是小痞子，林立可没那口气，八级魔兽可不是开玩笑的，就算是在这落日山脉当中，也绝对算得上是食物链中层的生物了。
不过在确定是利维坦猩猩的同时，林立也微微松了一口气。
如果是其他魔兽，伊娜现在可能已经凶多吉少了，也只有遇上利维坦猩猩，才暂时没有什么生命危险，比起其他凶残魔兽来，利维坦猩猩并不太热中于杀戮，就如同安度因所说，它们只是一群喜欢捣乱的小痞子。
“抓走伊娜的应该是利维坦猩猩。”
“利维坦猩猩？”
“落日山脉中的另类，一种并不太热中于杀戮的魔兽，如果我没猜错的话，伊娜现在可能在哭，但应该没有生命危险。”林立望着地上那杂乱的脚印，又低声补充道：“从脚印上看，应该只有一只。”

听到情况并不象想象中那么恶劣，罗麦格雷尼由微微松了口气。
两人再不去管克伦威尔，只是沿着小溪旁的脚印一路往前找去。
林立确实没有猜错，还在很远的地方，两人就听见了伊娜的哭声。
哭声是从一片密林中传来的，远远望去，那片密林里的树木似乎特别的高大，树叶也似乎特别的茂盛，而在那一棵棵高大的树木之间，却布满了坚韧的藤条，这一根根藤条连在一起，就仿佛一张巨网一般。
林立曾经听安度因讲过，这是利维坦猩猩特有的建筑方式，它们用藤条编织成一张巨网，领地扩张到什么地方，巨网就覆盖到什么地方，对于利维坦猩猩来说，这张巨网既是它的巢穴，也是它最有力的武器，凭借着这一张巨网，利维坦猩猩能够办到许多连高级魔兽都无法办到的事。
而被抓走的长腿美女，此时就正被困在那巨网当中。
“走开！你这个怪物……给我走开呀！”哭喊声中，伊娜正拼命的挣扎着。
听见伊娜的哭喊声，两人赶紧跑上前去。
一到树下才看见，伊娜正被绑在巨网当中，藤条缠了一层又一层，仿佛一只大粽子似的，而那利维坦猩猩，却不知从什么地方搞来一只画笔，此时正一边在伊娜脸上画着圈圈，一边发出“嘎嘎嘎嘎”的怪笑声。
“靠！”林立忽然觉得，这利维坦猩猩真是有些变态，身为一头魔兽，抓了人类不撕不咬，却偏偏用笔在人脸上画圈圈，这不是变态是什么？
“伊娜！”毕竟是父女连心，罗麦格雷尼见女儿痛哭，站在树下更着急得不行。
可他这一心急，却忘了树上的是一头八级魔兽。
“爸爸小心！”长腿美女的声音还没来得及落下，林立就忽然听见一阵破空之声传来，紧接着就是一声闷响，刚刚还呼喊着女儿名字的罗麦格雷尼连躲都没来得及躲，就被一只从天而降的椰子给砸得晕了过去。
“嘎嘎嘎嘎！”一椰子砸倒了地上的人类，那利维坦猩猩更是兴奋得不行，一边跳着一边怪笑，甚至还转身对两人扭了扭屁股。
“……”有了罗麦格雷尼教训，林立赶忙躲到一棵树后，以防那死猩猩又用椰子偷袭。
谁知道他才刚侧身躲到树后，就忽然感觉脚下一轻，紧接着整个人都倒了过来。
“我靠！”林立怎么也没有想到，自己藏身的树下，竟然藏着一根藤条，那藤条一端打了一个活结，另一段却在利维坦猩猩手中，只见那死猩猩将藤条一拉，林立整个人就被吊了起来。
林立反应也是极快，人在空中飞速上升，心头却是异常冷静，也不见他如何吟唱咒语，只是一个奇异的手势，一发风刃已经发出了尖锐的破空之声。
凭着这一发风刃，将那条阴险的藤条切断，同时一个羽落术加在自己身上，林立总算是险险的逃出了陷阱，只是随之而来的，却又是一阵如狂风暴雨般的椰子袭击。
也不知道那死猩猩从哪里搞来这么多椰子，一通狂风暴雨般的乱砸，至少弄了数百个椰子下来。

这一通乱砸，直砸得林立苦不堪言。
利维坦猩猩可是真正的八级魔兽，这一颗椰子从它手上砸下来，连罗麦格雷尼这个战士都当场被砸得晕了过去，更何况是身体并不强壮的林立。
每只椰子砸在身上，林立都感觉象是被炮弹射中似的。
实在是太粗暴了，一只接一只的椰子砸下，直压得林立连头都抬不起来。
这中间林立也有一些反击的机会，或是两记风刃，或是几根冰锥，只是这些法术，却大多落到了坚韧的藤条之上。
利维坦猩猩对那张巨网的控制，简直就象是手臂一般灵活，翻来覆去的扭动当中，竟是挡下了绝大多数的法术。
就算偶尔有那么一两个法术，侥幸穿过巨网拦截，射到了利维坦猩猩身上，也很难造成什么实质性的伤害。
八级魔兽的抗打击能力，比起狮蝎支流有着天壤之别，对林立来说，这些法术的作用，恐怕也只能是激发利维坦猩猩的怒气，让它将椰子砸得更猛一些。
数十记风刃，数十根冰锥，若是换个其他魔法师来，恐怕早已耗尽了所有的魔力，也只有林立这种精神力严重畸形的变态，才能继续在椰子雨中坚持下去。
但就算是林立，此时也有些绝望了。
content_en:
Chapter 8 Leviathan Orangutan (released, please vote + flowers)
The direction where the sound came from was near the water source that Romagnaney mentioned before.
The two ran out of the cave one after the other and saw Cromwell running back like a bereaved dog.
"The monster...the monster...the monster took...inna away!" Cromwell looked extremely embarrassed. His luxurious mage robe was covered with mud, sand and leaves, and he looked out of breath when he spoke.
When Lin Li saw this scene, he couldn't help but shook his head secretly.
This guy is really worthless. It’s no wonder that when Ro McGraney followed him out just now, his face looked a little ugly. If I had a daughter like this, I wouldn’t be happy for you to associate with her...
"What kind of monster? Please make it clear!" When it came to his own daughter, Romeg's eyes turned red with anger. His eyes that stared at Cromwell no longer had the previous politeness with a hint of alienation.
"Just...just now...just now when Ina and I were going to fetch water, a monster suddenly appeared next to us! It, it, it...it gave Ina..."
"Damn!" Lin Li said a curse word. He no longer cared about this weakling. He used another swift technique on himself and passed through the dense jungle like the wind.
Behind the jungle, there is a gurgling stream. This is probably the water source that Romagnaney mentioned. Beside the stream, a water bag is quietly sitting on the fallen leaves. The clear water in it has not yet drained out, and is gurgling out.
Lin Li bent down to pick up the water bag, put it to his ear and shook it. He found that there was still half a bag of clean water inside.
"She shouldn't have gone far yet!"
Looking at the footprints on the ground, they were extremely messy, ranging from large to small, deep and shallow. The small ones should have been left by Ina and Cromwell, but the large footprints made Lin Li gasp!
"Leviathan Orangutan!" Lin Li believed that he was right. These were definitely the footprints of the eighth-level monster Leviathan Orangutan. He had seen them outside Anduin's hut once or twice before when he was on the mountain. But at this time, the old guy would always say in an understatement that a few gangsters wanted to come and cause trouble, but I drove them away...
Anduin could regard them as little ruffians, but Lin Li didn't have that tone. Level eight monsters were no joke. Even in the Sunset Mountains, they were definitely considered to be creatures in the middle of the food chain.
However, when it was confirmed that it was the Leviathan orangutan, Lin Li also breathed a sigh of relief.
If it were other monsters, Ina might be in danger now. Only when she met the Leviathan orangutans, her life was not in danger for the time being. Compared to other ferocious monsters, the Leviathan orangutans were not too keen on killing. As Anduin said, they were just a group of little ruffians who liked to cause trouble.
"The one who captured Ina should be the Leviathan gorilla."
"Leviathan?"
"An alternative in the Sunset Mountains, a kind of monster that is not too keen on killing. If I guessed correctly, Ina may be crying now, but her life should not be in danger." Lin Li looked at the messy footprints on the ground and added in a low voice: "Judging from the footprints, there should be only one."
Hearing that the situation was not as bad as imagined, Romeg Greni was slightly relieved.
The two of them ignored Cromwell and just followed the footprints beside the creek to find him.
Lin Li's guess was indeed correct. They heard Ina's cry while still far away.
The cry came from a dense forest. From a distance, the trees in the dense forest seemed to be particularly tall and the leaves seemed to be particularly lush. But between the tall trees, they were covered with tough vines. The vines were connected together like a giant net.
Lin Li once heard Anduin say that this is a unique construction method of the Leviathan orangutans. They weave rattan into a giant net, and their territory can be expanded to wherever they go.The giant net covers everywhere. For the Leviathan orangutan, this giant net is not only its lair, but also its most powerful weapon. With this giant net, the Leviathan orangutan can do many things that even high-level monsters cannot do.
The long-legged beauty who was captured was currently trapped in the giant net.
"Go away! You monster...go away!" Amid the cry, Ina was struggling desperately.
Hearing Ina's cry, the two hurried forward.
As soon as they arrived under the tree, they saw that Ina was tied up in a giant net, with vines wrapped layer by layer, like a big rice dumpling. The Leviathan gorilla got a paintbrush from somewhere and was drawing circles on Ina's face while making weird laughter.
"Damn!" Lin Li suddenly felt that this Leviathan gorilla was really perverted. As a monster, it would not tear or bite humans when it caught them, but it would draw circles on people's faces with a pen. Isn't this a pervert?
"Ina!" After all, it was a father-daughter relationship. Seeing his daughter crying, Romagna was even more anxious when he stood under the tree.
But in his hurry, he forgot that the thing on the tree was an eighth-level monster.
"Dad, be careful!" Before the long-legged beauty's voice could even finish, Lin Li suddenly heard a sound piercing the air, followed by a muffled sound. Romegrani, who had just called his daughter's name, didn't even have time to hide, and was knocked unconscious by a coconut falling from the sky.
"Quack, quack, quack!" A coconut knocked down the human on the ground. The Leviathan orangutan was even more excited, jumping and laughing strangely, and even turned around and twisted its buttocks at the two of them.
"..." After receiving the lesson from Macgrani, Lin Li hurriedly hid behind a tree to prevent the dead orangutan from sneaking up on him with coconuts again.
Who knew that just as he hid behind a tree, he suddenly felt a lightness under his feet, and then his whole body fell over.
"Holy shit!" Lin Li never thought that there was a cane hidden under the tree where he was hiding. One end of the cane was tied with a slip knot, and the other part was in the hands of the Leviathan orangutan. When the dead orangutan pulled the cane, Lin Li was hung up.
Lin Li's reaction was also extremely fast. He was rising rapidly in the air, but his heart was extremely calm. It was not seen how he chanted the incantation. It was just a strange gesture, and a wind blade made a sharp sound of breaking through the air.
With this wind blade, he cut off the insidious vine, and at the same time applied a Feather Falling Technique on himself. Lin Li finally narrowly escaped the trap, but what followed was another coconut attack like a violent storm.
I don't know where the dead orangutan got so many coconuts from. He smashed them like a storm and got at least hundreds of coconuts down.
This random attack made Lin Li miserable.
The Leviathan orangutan is a real eighth-level monster. When a coconut was smashed from its hand, even the soldier Romagrain was knocked unconscious on the spot, let alone Lin Li, who was not very strong.
Every time a coconut hit his body, Lin Li felt as if he had been shot by a cannonball.
It was so rough that coconuts were smashed down one after another, so much that Lin Li couldn't even lift his head.
Lin Li also had some opportunities to counterattack, either with two wind blades or a few ice picks, but most of these spells fell on the tough rattan.
The Leviathan orangutan's control of the giant web was as flexible as an arm. While twisting and turning, it actually blocked most of the spells.
Even if one or two spells occasionally get through the giant net and hit the Leviathan orangutan, it will be difficult to cause any substantial damage.
The anti-strike ability of the eighth-level monsters is vastly different from that of the Manticore tributary. For Lin Li, the effect of these spells may only be to arouse the anger of the Leviathan orangutan and make him angry.It smashes the coconut harder.
Dozens of wind blades and dozens of ice picks. If it were any other magician, all the magic power would have been exhausted. Only a pervert like Lin Li with severe mental deformity could continue to persevere in the coconut rain.
But even Lin Li was a little desperate at this time.
